chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Ben Webster tries McRae's Selmer
summary: Webster blew McRae's horn at the Paramount and immediately bought one at Manny's, starting a switch from Conn to Selmer.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

He say, "(inaudible). I say, "If you try that horn, that horn is so good -- man, if you try that horn, you ain't gonna never want to go back to that Conn." I say, "Don't touch it now. You gonna blow it." So he (inaudible) -- he blowed the horn. That thing just -- you know Ben could play. He put it down. Right after that, he left me, went right over to 48th Street to Manny's and say, "Give me a Selmer." He bought him a Selmer that same day. And this is the beginning when all the guys began to change over from Conn to Selmer instruments. We found out they were better, they wear -- you know, you can get more out of them.
